title: ChatGPT Beyond English: Towards a Comprehensive Evaluation of Large Language Models in Multilingual Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the zero-shot learning performance of ChatGPT across 7 different NLP tasks (POS Tagging, NER, Relation Extraction, NLI, Question Answering, Common Sense Reasoning, and Summarization) in 37 diverse languages. The methodology compares model performance across languages categorized by resource availability (high, medium, low, and extremely low resources) to measure the performance disparity and bias toward English.
